title: Dragon and Triple Goddess
description: A surreal scene featuring three green-skinned female figures in profile facing left, their ornate headdresses and bodies merging with intricate patterns. A large black dragon with glowing orange fire in its mouth and along its neck emerges from swirling purple smoke above them, set against a luminous green circular portal with radiating lines and floating embers.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with three green-skinned women in profile facing left, their bodies and elaborate headdresses blending into intricate circular patterns and scales. A massive black dragon with glowing orange fire breathing from its open maw rises from swirling purple and black smoke above them. Behind the figures is a large luminous green circular portal with radiating geometric lines and floating golden embers, dark rocky formations frame the sides, in a detailed psychedelic painting style.
